none: PAS NLM-60B746: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of house of Constantine, probably Trier mint Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Roma draped or mantled and helmeted left. Obverse inscription: VRBS [ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars over. Pellet ends to stellar rays and pelleted wolf dugs. In exergue: [?*]TRS. Diameter: 14.8mm, Weight: 1.21gms, die axis: 12
